blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Wednesday said the government will not stop Filipino youth from pursuing careers abroad despite the decline in labor force participation. A study from the Philippine Institute of Development Studies noted that labor force participation has dropped down, raising questions about long-term workforce sustainability. This suggests that while jobs are being created, Filipinos may be shifting to overseas employment or leaving the labor force altogether for personal reasons.
